mapper.select: SELECT r.idx, r.store_id, r.user_id, r.order_order_id, r.rating, r.images, r.content, r.created_datetime, r.modified_datetime, r.reply_content, r.reply_datetime, s.name as store_name, s.category as store_category, u.name as user_name FROM tb_review r INNER JOIN tb_store s ON r.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY r.created_datetime DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.idx, r.store_id, r.user_id, r.order_order_id, r.rating, r.images, r.content, r.created_datetime, r.modified_datetime, r.reply_content, r.reply_datetime, s.name as store_name, s.category as store_category, u.name as user_name FROM tb_review r INNER JOIN tb_store s ON r.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_datetime DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.idx, r.store_id, r.user_id, r.order_order_id, r.rating, r.images, r.content, r.created_datetime, r.modified_datetime, r.reply_content, r.reply_datetime, s.name as store_name, s.category as store_category, u.name as user_name FROM tb_review r INNER JOIN tb_store s ON r.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.idx = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_review (store_id, user_id, order_order_id, rating, content, images, created_datetime, modified_datetime) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{userId}, #{orderOrderId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images}, #{createdDatetime}, #{modifiedDatetime})
mapper.select: SELECT #{storeId} as store_id, COUNT(*) as total_reviews, COALESCE(AVG(CAST(rating AS DECIMAL(3, 2))), 0.0) as average_rating, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rating_5_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rating_4_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rating_3_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rating_2_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rating_1_count FROM tb_review WHERE store_id = #{storeId}
